global_story_lock: Cheng Ye was Su Wang's rally teammate. He still had a pulse after the crash. Team doctor Shen Heng falsely described repeated marrow aspiration as an intraosseous rescue procedure, then refrigerated and moved the remains. Su Wang supplied garage 302 and concealed evidence but was not the direct killer. Container-07 is an illegal donor identifier, never a resurrection medicine. Vampire perception may suggest a test but is never legal proof.
